reviewNotes: Reviewed the complete Rust 1.99.0 standard-library aggregate and all twelve standalone sysroot license texts. The standalone texts, in-tree notices and retained component notice bodies are unchanged from 1.98.1; dependency versions changed without new license expressions, and libc author metadata changed in the upstream aggregate. Preserve that complete aggregate and every notice/exception; compiler implementation dependencies remain outside the inventory. The new x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu standard-library/notice fingerprint was exported from the verified official Rust 1.99.0 sysroot in hosted CI run 37112635227 at commit 1a68553b. Its canonical listing was composed with the reviewed current Fedora native inputs and notice hashes; no Rust 1.99.0 compilation or linkage on Fedora has been observed. The native allowlist is the five startup paths previously observed in server/TUI maps; actual future host builds must validate their native/import closure and reject any additional path or library. Read-only comparison to owning RPM metadata verified SHA-256, size and mode for all five current startup objects and four installed license texts. GCC remains gcc-16.2.1-2.fc44.x86_64; glibc/glibc-devel are now 2.43-9.fc44, correcting pre-existing drift from the old 2.43-8 record. The actual glibc-2.43-9.fc44.src.rpm from https://kojipkgs.fedoraproject.org/packages/glibc/2.43/9.fc44/src/glibc-2.43-9.fc44.src.rpm has SHA-256 d6b8d4996833c929f1c755abbe8ed5c24ec1798dfd3ce8c5c06b0fa15fa35e70. Its spec pins glibc-2.43-71-g9cda6fc96a, matching RPM changelog upstream commit 9cda6fc96abd035d9cbe68482138d4a78a51a7d5. The exact upstream start.S/crti.S/crtn.S license headers were read from GNU Sourceware and are byte-identical to the retained unlimited linking/distribution permission in legal/manual/glibc/x86_64-startup-notices.txt. All four Fedora patches extracted from that source RPM affect only localedata, CS_PATH, Python benchmark files or an s390 Makefile; none changes these startup sources. Retain glibc LICENSES/LGPL-2.1 and its startup linking permission, and GCC GPLv3/GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1. The GNU loader, libc, libm and libgcc_s remain allowed system imports, not bundled. This review approves only the fingerprinted files; different native bytes or an actual new link outside the allowlist requires another review.
description: Rust 1.99.0 standard-library and Fedora 44 glibc 2.43-9/GCC 16.2.1 startup/runtime notices for x86_64 GNU/Linux host builds. The native allowlist covers five reviewed startup objects with glibc linking permission and GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1; system loader/C/math/GCC shared libraries are not bundled.
